developer.title: Developer
developer.description: Runtime details, model controls, and the last run.
developer.webgpuHint: Runs the model on the GPU for a large speed boost when the browser and hardware support it.
developer.simdHint: WebAssembly SIMD speeds up the CPU fallback used when WebGPU is not available.
developer.threadsHint: Shared memory threads let the CPU fallback use several cores in parallel.
developer.coresHint: Logical cores reported by the browser, used to size the Wasm thread pool.
developer.executionProviderHint: The backend that runs the model. webgpu is fastest, wasm is the compatible fallback on older devices.
developer.precisionHint: Weight precision. q8 is the smallest download, fp32 is the most accurate and the largest.
developer.maskModeHint: How model output becomes alpha. minmax matches the reference tool, sigmoid gives a softer, more contrasty mapping.
developer.outputFormatHint: PNG keeps transparency, WebP is smaller, JPEG is the smallest but has no transparency.
developer.cutoffHint: Makes everything below this alpha level fully transparent. Useful for trimming halos and stray pixels.
developer.gammaHint: Bends the alpha curve. Below 1 keeps more of the subject, above 1 tightens soft edges.
developer.tilingHint: Runs the model on overlapping tiles for large images so edges stay sharp. Slower to run.
developer.invertHint: Swaps the subject and the background.
developer.featherHint: Softens the mask edge by a few pixels. 0 turns it off.
developer.refineHint: Feathers with a guided filter that follows image edges instead of blurring across them. Needs feather above 0.
developer.qualityHint: Encoder quality for the lossy formats WebP and JPEG. PNG is always lossless and ignores it.
